notes.title: Time To Stop Time - Localization
notes.content:
Time To Stop Time will be localized for these languages - Both Subtitles & Interface.

- Portuguese-Brazil
- Chinese
- German
- Russian
- Spanish

Time To Stop Time will release on 6th November 2020.
